'''Emlita''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who worked as a medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, she operated a stall in the [[Ambassador Commons]]' [[Alien Enclave Market]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Voss-Ka]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Emlita wore [[Color/Legends|grey]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] while at her stall. She had green skin, no hair and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Emlita first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game she serves as a Republic and Imperial medium armor vendor on the planet Voss. Her location is also marked on a map in [[Prima Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.
